remarks: A Home with Heart in Silver CreekImagine stepping into a classic two-story home that's been well-maintained for many years. This charming four-bedroom, one-and-a-half-bath residence is ready to welcome new owners to make their own memories and mark their place in the neighborhood.As you approach the house, you'll notice its well-maintained vinyl siding and the inviting enclosed front porch—complete with blinds that convey with the sale. This is a perfect spot to settle in with your morning coffee, create a cozy reading nook, or greet visiting friends. Step inside, and you'll immediately notice the beautiful original woodwork that graces the interior, a testament to the quality craftsmanship of an earlier era. While the home does need some updating to bring it fully into the modern age, its solid bones and authentic character shine through.The layout includes four spacious bedrooms, offering plenty of room for multiple purposes—whether you need a primary suite, guest rooms, home offices, or creative spaces. The 1.5 bathrooms serve the household well, and the one-car garage with shared driveway provides convenient parking. But perhaps one of the best features is the wonderful covered back porch—an extension of the home perfect for entertaining, relaxing, or simply enjoying the outdoors while staying protected from the elements.Being sold as-is, this home is ideal for buyers who appreciate real character and envision the potential in a property with good bones. What's more, you'll be within easy walking distance to the charming Village of Silver Creek, where shops, restaurants, and community life await just around the corner.This is more than just a house—it's a home waiting for its next chapte
